title: Sign in
notConnectedYet: Authentication will be enabled in a later phase.

notConnected.title: Authentication not connected
notConnected.description: No auth provider is wired yet. Use demo mode to continue, or retry later.

validation.displayNameMin: Name is too short (at least 2 characters).
validation.displayNameMax: Name is too long (60 characters max).
validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.passwordMax: Password is too long (72 characters max).
validation.passwordWeak: Include at least one letter and one digit.
validation.passwordSameAsOld: The new password matches the current one.
validation.consentRequired: You must accept the terms and privacy policy to continue.
validation.deletionPhraseRequired: Type the confirmation word to continue.
validation.deletionAckRequired: You must acknowledge the impact of deletion.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Choose how to enter. You can browse as a guest now and create an account later.
welcome.guestNotice: Guests browse public sections only. They cannot request assistance, donate, save a profile, or access any beneficiary data.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Enter your email and password. In demo mode nothing is sent to a server.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.subtitle: A few details are enough to start. You can complete your profile later.
signUp.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
signUp.terms: I accept the terms and conditions (draft copy).
signUp.privacy: I accept the privacy policy (draft copy).
signUp.roleHint: Intent grants no sensitive permission. Staff roles are granted after human review.

verify.title: Verify your account
verify.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code.
verify.maxAttempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email to issue a reset code.
forgot.notice: We never reveal whether an email is registered. If an account exists, it receives a reset code.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Enter the code, then your new password.
reset.success: Password updated. Sign in with it.

codes.AUTH_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and retry.
codes.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email is already registered. Try signing in.
codes.OTP_EXPIRED: The code expired. Request a new one.
codes.OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS: Attempts exhausted. Request a new code.
codes.NO_PENDING_VERIFICATION: No pending verification for this account.
codes.NO_SESSION: No active session. Sign in first.

devTools.title: Demo auth tools
devTools.subtitle: Internal tools to test roles and sessions in demo mode only.
devTools.noSession: No active demo session. Sign in, then press refresh.
devTools.rolesHint: Changing roles here is demo-only. Real enforcement is server-side in P18.
devTools.notDemo: These tools work in demo mode only.

security.changeNote: Your current password is required to re-authenticate before changing it.
security.biometricNote: When enabled, biometrics are required before opening the security screen.
security.biometricUnavailable: Biometrics are unavailable on this device or none are enrolled.
security.biometricPrompt: Confirm your identity to open security
security.lockedDescription: Confirm your identity with biometrics to continue.

devices.demoNote: These are demo sessions on this device. No real devices are registered before the backend is wired.
devices.emptyDescription: Sign in to see the sessions active on this device.
devices.serverNote: Revoking sessions on other devices is enforced server-side in P18.

deletion.policyPending: The retention window and confirmation period are not approved by the owner yet; the current value is provisional.

deleted.title: What gets deleted
deleted.body: Your profile, photo, notification preferences, and contact details linked to your account.

anonymized.title: What gets anonymized
anonymized.body: Donation and disbursement records are stripped of identity and kept as aggregate figures for financial transparency.

retained.title: What is legally retained
retained.body: Audit records and financial entries the law requires us to keep for the statutory period.

deletion.confirmNote: Re-enter your password, type the confirmation word {{phrase}}, then acknowledge the impact.
deletion.ackLabel: I understand deletion is final after the confirmation period.
deletion.scheduledFor: Deletion runs on {{date}} (in {{days}} days). You can cancel during this period.
deletion.serverNote: The final server purge activates in P18. The request and its cancellation are real now.

export.contentsBody: Your account data, consents, sessions, profile, and preferences — as readable JSON.
export.noticeNoTokens: The file contains no passwords or session tokens.
export.noticeNoOtherUsers: The file contains no data about other users.
export.noticeDemo: In demo mode the data is demo data and labeled as such.
export.savedOnly: File saved at: {{uri}} (sharing is unavailable on this device).
